body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a Standard within 2 units. Until your next turn, allies within 2 units ignore the first die they would burn.

surges.html: If an affected ally is already Rallied, it gains +1 Defense until its next turn instead.
Reduce forced movement against one affected ally by 1 unit until your next turn.

rider.title: STANDARD — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority to strengthen your Standard until your next turn: 1–3 +1 unit radius; 4–5 allies inside gain +1 Defense; 6+ both effects apply.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
